desc_ko: 조선 궁궐과 한옥 골목, 시장과 야경이 한 도시에 모인 수도.
desc_en: Korea's capital: Joseon palaces, hanok alleys, markets and night views in one city.
note_en: Gyeongbokgung Palace is closed on Tuesdays.

desc_ko: 바다와 시장, 산비탈 마을이 이어진 항구 도시.
desc_en: A port city of beaches, fish markets and hillside villages.
festival_en: Busan Fireworks Festival (Nov 7, 2026, Gwangalli) · Busan International Film Festival

desc_ko: 분지라 여름이 유난히 덥고, 시장과 골목 먹거리가 강한 도시.
desc_en: A basin city with very hot summers and strong market and alley food.
note_en: July and August are extremely hot.
festival_en: Daegu Chimac Festival (early July, Duryu Park)

desc_ko: 과학과 철도의 도시. 빵지순례 여행지로 유명해요.
desc_en: A city of science and railways, famous for bakery trips.
note_en: Expect long weekend lines at Sungsimdang.

desc_ko: 예술과 민주화 역사의 도시. 남도 음식의 중심이에요.
desc_en: A city of art and democracy history, at the heart of southern Korean food.
note_en: The 16th Gwangju Biennale runs until Nov 15 (VisitKorea listing).

desc_ko: 동해 바다와 커피 거리, 천년 축제 단오제의 도시.
desc_en: East Sea beaches, a coffee street and the thousand-year Danoje festival.
festival_ko: 강릉단오제 (유네스코 인류무형문화유산, 매년 음력 5월 단오 무렵)
festival_en: Gangneung Danoje (UNESCO intangible heritage, around Dano in early summer)

desc_ko: 천년 신라의 수도. 도시 전체가 노천 박물관이에요.
desc_en: Capital of the Silla kingdom for a thousand years. The whole city is an open-air museum.

desc_ko: 한옥마을과 음식으로 유명한 전북의 중심 도시.
desc_en: Jeonbuk's main city, famous for its hanok village and food.
festival_en: Jeonju International Film Festival (spring) · Bibimbap Festival (moved to Deokjin Park in 2026)

desc_en: A south-coast port famous for its night sea.

desc_ko: 제주 북쪽 중심 도시. 공항이 있어 제주 여행의 출발점이에요.
desc_en: Jeju's northern hub and the starting point of most trips, with the airport.

desc_ko: 제주 남쪽. 폭포와 해안 절경, 감귤의 고장이에요.
desc_en: Jeju's south side: waterfalls, coastal cliffs and tangerine farms.
A south-coast peninsula known for the Naro Space Center and yuja citron.
Highlands 700 m above sea level and host of the 2018 Winter Olympics.
festival_en: Hyoseok Culture Festival (Bongpyeong, buckwheat blossom season)

desc_ko: 다리로 이어진 섬. 계단식 다랭이논과 바다가 아름다워요.
desc_en: An island linked by bridges, with terraced rice fields over the sea.

desc_ko: 동해 한가운데 화산섬. 지금은 배로만 갈 수 있고, 울릉공항은 2028년 개항이 목표예요.
desc_en: A volcanic island in the middle of the East Sea. Ferry only for now; the airport is targeted for 2028.
note_ko: 겨울엔 풍랑으로 결항이 잦아요. 2026년 11월 기사 기준 강릉 노선은 운항 중단, 독도 관광선은 11월 6일부터 겨울 휴항이에요. 일정에 하루 여유를 두세요.
note_en: Winter sailings are often cancelled by high seas. As of November 2026 news, the Gangneung route is suspended and Dokdo tour boats have been in winter break since Nov 6. Leave a spare day.
festival_en: Ulleungdo Squid Festival (Jul 17–19, 2026, 24th, around Jeodong Port)

desc_ko: 우리나라 가장 동쪽 섬. 울릉도에서 관광선을 타고 가며, 일반인은 동도 선착장에만 내릴 수 있어요.
desc_en: Korea's easternmost islands, reached by tour boat from Ulleungdo. Visitors may land only at the Dongdo wharf.
note_ko: 관광선은 울릉 사동·저동·도동항에서 떠나고 편도 약 1시간 30분~2시간, 운임은 성인 약 6만 원부터(2025년 안내)예요. 날씨에 따라 출항해도 배를 대지 못하고 돌아올 수 있어요. 2026년은 11월 6일부터 겨울 휴항이에요.
note_en: Tour boats leave from Sadong, Jeodong and Dodong ports on Ulleung, about 1.5–2 hours each way, from about 60,000 won for adults (2025 listings). In bad weather the boat may sail round without landing. Winter break since Nov 6, 2026.

desc_ko: 공항과 항구의 도시. 차이나타운과 개항장 거리가 있어요.
desc_en: City of the airport and port, with Chinatown and the old open-port streets.

desc_ko: 산업 도시이자 고래와 태화강 정원의 도시.
desc_en: An industrial city known for whales and the Taehwa River garden.
Korea's administrative city, with a large lake park and arboretum.
The city of Suwon Hwaseong Fortress, built by King Jeongjo.

desc_ko: 판교 IT 단지와 모란시장이 있는 도시.
desc_en: Home to the Pangyo tech hub and Moran Market.

desc_ko: 부대찌개거리로 유명한 경기 북부 중심 도시.
desc_en: A northern Gyeonggi hub known for its budae-jjigae street.

desc_ko: 예술공원과 신도시가 있는 서울 남쪽 도시.
desc_en: A city south of Seoul with an art park.
A city of comics and fantastic film.
Known for Gwangmyeong Cave, a revived old mine.

desc_ko: 평택항과 평택호가 있는 경기 남부 도시.
desc_en: A southern Gyeonggi city with a port and lake.

desc_ko: 소요산 단풍으로 알려진 경기 북부 도시.
desc_en: A northern Gyeonggi city known for Soyosan autumn colors.
A west-coast city with Daebudo Island and a multicultural street.
A city of Ilsan Lake Park and a flower expo.
A small city with Seoul Grand Park and a science museum.

desc_ko: 한강변 꽃밭과 조선 왕릉이 있는 도시.
desc_en: A riverside city with flower fields and Joseon royal tombs.
A riverside city where the North and South Han rivers meet.
A quiet city with the Mulhyanggi Arboretum.
A west-coast city with tidal creeks and Oido.
Known for its spring azalea hill.
Home to the Railroad Museum and Wangsong Lake.

desc_ko: 한강과 검단산, 대형 쇼핑몰이 있는 도시.
desc_en: A city by the Han River with Geomdansan and a big mall.
A city of theme parks and a folk village.

desc_ko: 분단의 현장과 예술 마을이 함께 있는 접경 도시.
desc_en: A border city with DMZ sites and art villages.
A city of rice and ceramics.
Home of brassware and Namsadang folk performers.

desc_ko: 한강 하구와 서해가 만나는 접경 도시.
desc_en: A border city where the Han River meets the West Sea.

desc_ko: 섬과 포구, 조선 왕릉이 있는 넓은 서해안 도시.
desc_en: A large west-coast city of islands, ports and royal tombs.
note_en: The road to Jebudo floods at high tide.

desc_en: Home to Namhansanseong Fortress and Hwadam Forest.
Known for globe-amaranth fields and Hoeamsa temple site.
A city of Sanjeong Lake and Idong galbi.
note_en: Korea National Arboretum needs a reservation.

desc_en: A rice-growing city on the South Han River with King Sejong's tomb.
A city of lakes and dakgalbi.

desc_ko: 출렁다리와 뮤지엄 산이 있는 강원 남부 중심 도시.
desc_en: Southern Gangwon's hub, with a suspension bridge and Museum SAN.
An east-coast city with Mureung Valley and Candlestick Rock.
A highland city where the Han and Nakdong rivers begin.

desc_ko: 설악산과 바다, 수산시장을 함께 즐기는 도시.
desc_en: Seoraksan, the sea and a seafood market in one city.
A city of caves and a coastal rail bike.

desc_ko: 충북의 중심. 공예와 대통령 별장 청남대로 알려졌어요.
desc_en: Chungbuk's main city, known for crafts and the Cheongnamdae presidential villa.
festival_en: Cheongju Craft Biennale (every two years; next in 2027)

desc_en: A city of Chungju Lake and Suanbo hot springs.
note_en: Geonji Sunset Forest recently opened (VisitKorea listing).

desc_ko: 청풍호와 의림지의 도시. 반값여행 시범 지역이에요.
desc_en: A city of Cheongpung Lake and Uirimji. A half-price pilot region.
Home of the Independence Hall and walnut cakes.

desc_ko: 백제의 옛 도읍. 공산성과 무령왕릉이 있어요.
desc_en: An old Baekje capital with Gongsanseong and King Muryeong's tomb.
festival_en: Baekje Cultural Festival (72nd in 2026, Gongju and Buyeo)

desc_en: Home of Daecheon Beach and the Mud Festival.

desc_ko: 온천과 민속마을, 이순신 장군의 현충사가 있어요.
desc_en: Hot springs, a folk village and Hyeonchungsa shrine to Admiral Yi.
A west-coast city with Haemieupseong and a Baekje rock-carved Buddha.
note_ko: 간월암은 물이 빠질 때만 걸어서 들어가요.
note_en: Ganwolam can be reached on foot only at low tide.

desc_en: A city of strawberries and Tapjeong Lake.
note_en: A Saturday city tour runs through November (VisitKorea listing).

desc_en: Home to the headquarters of Korea's three armed services.
Home to Solmoe Holy Site and Waemok, where you see both sunrise and sunset.
A port city with modern-history streets and the Gogunsan Islands.
A historic city with the Baekje Mireuksa temple site.
Famous for Naejangsan autumn colors.
The setting of Chunhyang's tale and a gateway to Jirisan.
A city of wide plains where you can see the horizon.

desc_ko: 유달산과 근대 거리, 바다 음식의 항구 도시.
desc_en: A port city of Yudalsan, modern streets and seafood.
An eco city with Suncheon Bay wetlands and a national garden.
Famous for Naju gomtang, pears and Yeongsanpo skate.
A port city famous for its spring plum-blossom village.
A city of Homigot sunrise and seafood.
festival_en: Pohang International Fireworks Festival (Nov 19–21, 2026, Yeongildae Beach)

desc_en: An inland Gyeongbuk city with Jikjisa Temple.
A city of Hahoe Village, Confucian academies and yangban culture.
An industrial Gyeongbuk city by Geumosan.
Home of Buseoksa, Sosuseowon and Museom Village.

desc_ko: 포도와 와인, 별 보기 좋은 보현산의 도시.
desc_en: A city of grapes, wine and stargazing on Bohyeonsan.
A city of dried persimmons and bicycles.
A city of the old Mungyeong Saejae pass and omija berries.
A city of the Gatbawi Buddha on Palgongsan and jujubes.
A city of Jinhae cherry blossoms and Masan fish market.
festival_en: Jinhae Gunhangje (opened Mar 27, 2026) · Masan Chrysanthemum Festival (Oct 31–Nov 8, 2026)

desc_en: A city of Jinjuseong Fortress and Namgang lanterns.

desc_ko: 한려수도의 항구 도시. 섬과 케이블카가 있어요.
desc_en: A port on the Hallyeo waterway, with islands and a cable car.
A city of a sea cable car and Samcheonpo Port.
The old capital of the Gaya kingdom.

desc_ko: 영남루와 얼음골의 도시. 반값여행 시범 지역이에요.
desc_en: Home of Yeongnamnu and Eoreumgol. A half-price pilot region.

desc_ko: 바람의 언덕과 외도가 있는 섬 도시.
desc_en: An island city with the Hill of Wind and Oedo.
A city next to Busan, home of Tongdosa.
